methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T
steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $27.10B (to $53.71B) × margin 15.0% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $20.14B
K = capital to build it: $27.10B ÷ sales-to-capital 0.83 = $32.53B
σ = 49% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $7.02B
assets in place = NOPAT $0 ÷ WACC = $0; value = ($0 + $7.02B + net cash $3.56B) ÷ 1,051,000,000 = $10.07

Return on new capital in perpetuity

methods.formula: Value = D₀ × [(1 + g_L) + H × (g_S − g_L)] ÷ (kₑ − g_L);  growth falls in a straight line from g_S to g_L over 2H years
